headline: RE_SOLUTION: Fernando Medina, former Mayor of Lisbon, at IE School of Architecture & Design
context: IE School of Architecture & Design (IE University) will launch the 2026–27 edition of its RE_SOLUTION public series with a lecture by Fernando Medina, Mayor of Lisbon from 2015 to 2021, followed by a conversation with Jo da Silva, Global Director of Sustainable Development at Aru

sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: IE School of Architecture & Design (IE University) will launch the 2026–27 edition of its RE_SOLUTION public series with a lecture by Fernando Medina, Mayor of Lisbon from 2015 to 2021, followed by a conversation with Jo da Silva, Global Director of Sustainable Development at Arup. RE_SOLUTION brings together former city leaders and experts to examine how cities respond to complex urban challenges through public infrastructure, transformative projects, policy, and collaboration across government, the private sector, academia, and civil society. Reflecting IE School of Architecture & Design’s holistic understanding of cities as sites of transformation across the built, natural, and digital environments,
